title: A lifechanging app
body:
Reaching you goals is hard. Motivation comes and goes. Willpower can easily disappear after a few days. Only discipline sticks through the weeks, months, and years.

But discipline is hard to build without starting somewhere. And this app solves that.

This app will help you keep on track — to reach your goals and sustain them. Start with simple and actionable tasks that you can do everyday. In 30 days, you’ll have genuinely formed new and productive habits.

title: An App that lets gives back your control in life.
body:
For years, I have been struggling with keeping “promises” to myself that I’ll do this and I’ll do that but to only realize after another few months, that I failed to keep those promises again. It’s been an actual struggle on my end and I desperately wanted to discipline myself given that the world is full of distractions. 

But soon later I came across this app, and it so far did help me form a good habit. Since I’m always on my phone everyday, it’s hard to miss these reminders as they pop up during the time you need them so I truly appreciate the development behind this app. However, as for the price, it’s too expensive on my end and I’m already a full time Program and Social Media manager but I did realize and said to myself...

“All those unproductive days would have been more costly than this”

and then I finally realized that, this was actually an investment rather than as an expense to improving my overall being.
